subject: Re: 20kVA generator - delivery
body:
Marko,

Separate matter - booking RB-20265951, the 1-tonne mini dumper. We returned it late because our driver got stuck in traffic on the way back to the depot. The 300 EUR late return fee doesn't seem fair given the circumstances. Can that be waived?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy
